summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release providing a business update on its strategic investment in K25.ai and its strengthened financial position. The release notes K25.ai's implied valuation rose to US$200 million, making NewGen's agreed 13% stake worth about US$26 million, generating an expected unrealized gain of US$8.5 million. It also discusses the pending issuance of 2.5 million Class A ordinary shares, which will bring total shares outstanding to roughly 5.9 million. This is purely an informational update on existing investments and share issuance plans; no special-situations transaction or event is announced.
